cases.scenario: Directional icon: arrow means 'next/forward' so it must follow reading direction
cases.brokenExample: author-marked progression arrow that never mirrors (/* rtl-icon: progression-right */)
cases.expectedLtr: arrows point right; breadcrumb chevrons separate Home > Products > Headphones left to right
cases.expectedRtl: arrows point left (next is to the left); breadcrumb order is Home first on the right with chevrons pointing left; broken: arrows keep pointing right
cases.expectedTransformation: yes: candidate adds .icon-forward:dir(rtl){scale:-1 1} (UNCERTAIN: many gating conditions: flat marked class, display box, no transform in stylesheet, ownership custom-css)
cases.actualAnalyzer: RTL.ICON.PROGRESSION at app/icons.css:5 (marker detected); NO candidate: manual review, CSS_ICON_OWNER_OR_INTENT_REVIEW; finding ownership reported 'unknown' although rtl-scanner.config.json has an ownerOverrides entry for stylesheet/.icon-forward.
cases.comparison: Detection as expected; the uncertain candidate did NOT materialise (manual only). Cause of ownership 'unknown' not investigated.
